items.title: Is it possible to translate a natural landscape into graphic design? And can the experience of a place be expressed visually? At the beginning of November 2025, 43 graphic design students from the Czech Republic and Switzerland met in the Giant Mountains in northern Czechia to try and answer these very questions.
